snapshot.text: Health care is run partly federally and partly by the emirates, with mandatory insurance in some emirates. In 2026 the president directed a national health insurance system for citizens across all emirates and an integrated national healthcare system.

priorities.title: National health insurance for citizens
priorities.text: A comprehensive national health insurance system covering all emirates.

priorities.title: Heat and climate health plan
priorities.text: A six-year plan to protect residents from heat, dust and poor air quality.

priorities.title: Genomics
priorities.text: Personalised health-risk reports for over 900,000 people from the Emirati Genome Programme.
